title: Shopping List
text:
Anna has a shopping list. She needs milk, eggs and bread. She goes to the shop on Monday.

The shop is near her house. She buys apples too. She likes red apples. She is happy when she finds everything on her list.

options: She is organized and plans ahead
She lives far from the shop

questions.text: Why does Anna make a shopping list?
options: So she does not forget what to buy
To give it to her friend

vocabulary.definition: a set of names or things written one after another
a place where you buy things
gets something by paying money for it

paragraph_translations: В Анни є список покупок. Їй потрібні молоко, яйця та хліб. Вона йде в магазин у понеділок.
Магазин поруч із її будинком. Вона також купує яблука. Їй подобаються червоні яблука. Вона щаслива, коли знаходить усе зі свого списку.
